correctness.rationale: All disjoint and mixed equivalence-class possibilities are exhausted. An affine-invariant equivalence on constants is a field-linear subspace W; unit classes correspond to a normal N≤V⋊Fq× constrained to act trivially on V/W. If W<V, only a translation subspace T≤W is possible; if W=V, only translation subspaces or V⋊H occur. The listed pairs explicitly give congruences, and count and chain height follow by Gaussian subspaces and divisors. The least commutative quotient follows from constants and the derived unit group. Exact finite independent partition enumeration for q=2 r=1,2 and q=3 r=1 agrees with the theorem; larger prime and extension-field constructed checks succeed. The finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: This is the complete classification of a natural all-parameter finite transformation monoid family. The flag lattice plus cyclic-subgroup upper interval gives closed formulas for all congruences and maximum chain height in arbitrary rank, and the q=2 least-commutative quotient differs structurally from all larger finite fields. This is motivated by recent explicit semigroup congruence studies and offers a nontrivial family of exact benchmarks for finite-index congruence enumeration; it is not an arbitrary finite isolated example.
